request.description:
Client sends:
```typescript
{ event: "typing:start" | "typing:stop", data: { conversationId: ObjectIdString } }
```

```typescript

```

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Starts email-based authentication. Sends a 6-digit code to the email or username in `identifier` and returns a short-lived `sessionId` used by the verification step.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
{ identifier: string } // email or username, 3..254 chars
```
### Response
```typescript
EmailSessionStartResponse
```
### Errors
404 `{ error: string }` | 429 RateLimitError

Verifies the 6-digit code for an email auth session. On success, confirms the session and keeps `sessionId` available for password setup or session status checks.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
{ sessionId: string; code: string } // code: 6 digits
```
### Response
```typescript
EmailVerifyResponse
```
### Errors
401 invalid code | 404 session | 429

Completes registration after email verification. Creates or updates the user credentials with `username` and `password`, then returns `user`, `accessToken`, and `refreshToken`.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
{ sessionId: string; username: string; password: string }
```
### Response
```typescript
AuthTokensResponse
```
### Errors
404 session | 409 username taken | 429

Authenticates an existing user by email or username plus password. Returns the user profile and fresh access/refresh tokens for authenticated requests.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
{ identifier: string; password: string }
```
### Response
```typescript
AuthTokensResponse
```
### Errors
401 invalid credentials | 429

Reads the current status of an email auth session by `sessionId`, for example to check whether it is verified or expired.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
AuthSessionStatusResponse
```
### Errors
404 session

Starts password reset for an existing account. Sends an email link when the user exists; copy the link query params into `resetSessionId` and `resetCode` for the confirm step.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
{ identifier: string }
```
### Response
```typescript
PasswordResetRequestResponse
```
### Errors
429

Finishes password reset using `resetSessionId`, `resetCode`, and a new password. On success, returns the user profile and new access/refresh tokens.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
{ sessionId: string; code: string; password: string }
```
### Response
```typescript
AuthTokensResponse
```
### Errors
401 invalid code | 404 session | 429

Rotates a valid refresh token and returns a new access token, a new refresh token, and the current user. Use this when `accessToken` expires.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
{ refreshToken: string }
```
### Response
```typescript
AuthTokensResponse
```
### Errors
401 invalid refresh token

Revokes the provided refresh token and flushes the authenticated user location cache. After this request, the old refresh token cannot be used again.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
{ refreshToken: string }
```
### Response
```typescript
{ success: true }
```
### Errors
None

---

## Types

```typescript

```
### Response

### Errors
Validation error if q missing

request.description:
Creates an authenticated public post at the provided coordinates. Public posts can appear in feed, map, and nearby readable post queries according to visibility rules.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
CreatePostBody with type: "public"
```
### Response
```typescript
Post
```
### Errors
403 forbidden | 429

Creates an authenticated post visible to the author and users who follow the author. This replaces the old followers-only post visibility.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
CreatePostBody with type: "followers"
```
### Response
```typescript
Post
```
### Errors
403 | 429

Creates an authenticated post inside `communityId` at the provided coordinates. The caller must be allowed to post in that community.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
CreatePostBody with type: "community" and communityId
```
### Response
```typescript
Post
```
### Errors
400 communityId required | 403 not a member | 429

Returns the authenticated user feed with posts that are visible to the current user.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
Post[]
```
### Errors
401

Fetches one post by `postId` for the authenticated user and supplied reader coordinates. The API rejects posts that are not visible or are outside the readable radius.

---

## Types
### Query params
```typescript
lng: number, lat: number
```
### Response
```typescript
Post
```
### Errors
404 not found | 403 `{ error: "Post is outside readable radius", point: MapPoint }`

Deletes `postId` as the authenticated author. Returns no content when deletion succeeds.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
204 empty
```
### Errors
404

item.name: Map

request.description:
Returns lightweight map points for posts visible to the authenticated user inside the bounding box defined by min/max longitude and latitude.

---

## Types
### Query params
```typescript
minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat, limit?, type?, communityId?, followingId?
```
### Response
```typescript
MapPoint[]
```
### Errors
400 viewport required | 401

Returns lightweight map points for posts visible to the authenticated user around `lng`/`lat` within `radiusMeters`.

---

## Types
### Query params
```typescript
lng, lat, radiusMeters?, limit?, type?, communityId?, followingId?
```
### Response
```typescript
MapPoint[]
```
### Errors
400 | 401

Returns full readable posts near the authenticated user coordinates. This is for nearby lists, not just map markers.

---

## Types
### Query params
```typescript
lng, lat, limit?, type?, communityId?, followingId?
```
### Response
```typescript
Post[]
```
### Errors
401

item.name: Follows & Blocks

request.description:
Follows `targetUserId` immediately when the account is `open`. Creates a pending follow request when the account is `closed`. Blocked users cannot follow each other.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
Follow (open account) | FollowRequest with HTTP 201 (closed account)
```
### Errors
400 self follow | 403 blocked | 404 user | 409 already following or request exists `{ error, request? }` | 429

Removes an active follow to `targetUserId`. If no follow exists, cancels a pending outgoing follow request to that user.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
204 empty (unfollow or cancel pending request)
```
### Errors
404 | 401

Lists pending follow requests received by the authenticated user. Used when the account is closed and other users request to follow.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
FollowRequest[]
```
### Errors
401

Lists pending follow requests sent by the authenticated user to closed accounts.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
FollowRequest[]
```
### Errors
401

Accepts an incoming follow request and creates the follow relationship. Only the target user of a closed account can accept.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
{ request: FollowRequest; follow: Follow }
```
### Errors
403 blocked | 404 | 401

Rejects an incoming follow request without creating a follow relationship.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
FollowRequest
```
### Errors
404 | 401

Lists follow records for users who follow `targetUserId`. Blocked relationships are filtered out.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
Follow[]
```
### Errors
None

Lists follow records for users that `targetUserId` follows. Blocked relationships are filtered out.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
Follow[]
```
### Errors
None

Blocks `targetUserId` for the authenticated user. Blocking prevents follow and message interactions with that user.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
UserBlock
```
### Errors
400 self block | 401

Removes the authenticated user block for `targetUserId`.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
204 empty
```
### Errors
404 | 401

Lists users blocked by the authenticated user.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
UserBlock[]
```
### Errors
401

item.description: Instagram-style follows with open/closed accounts. Entities: `Follow`, `FollowRequest`, `UserBlock`.

request.description:
Creates a new community owned by the authenticated user. `access` controls whether joining is immediate (`open`) or request-based (`closed`).

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
CreateCommunityBody
```
### Response
```typescript
Community
```
### Errors
401 validation

Fetches community details by `communityId`. Returns 404 when the community does not exist.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
Community
```
### Errors
404

Updates community metadata. Moderators can update basic profile fields; owner-only fields such as nickname or access require owner permissions.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
UpdateCommunityBody
```
### Response
```typescript
Community
```
### Errors
403 forbidden or owner required | 404

Joins an open community or creates a join request for a closed community as the authenticated user.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
{ member: CommunityMember } for open | { request: CommunityRequest } for closed
```
### Errors
404 | 409 already member | 429

Leaves `communityId` as the authenticated member. Community owners cannot leave their own community through this endpoint.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
{ success: true }
```
### Errors
400 owner cannot leave | 404

Returns posts from `communityId` that the authenticated user can read from the provided coordinates, including distance-based readability checks.

---

## Types
### Query params
```typescript
lng, lat
```
### Response
```typescript
Post[]
```
### Errors
401

Returns lightweight map points for posts in `communityId` visible to the authenticated user.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
MapPoint[]
```
### Errors
401

Deletes `postId` from `communityId` using community moderation permissions. Intended for moderators or owners.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
204 empty
```
### Errors
403 | 404

Lists pending join requests for `communityId`. Requires community moderation permissions.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
CommunityRequest[]
```
### Errors
403 | 401

Accepts `communityRequestId` for `communityId` and adds the requester as a community member. Requires moderation permissions.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
{ request: CommunityRequest; member: CommunityMember }
```
### Errors
403 | 404

Rejects `communityRequestId` for `communityId`. Requires moderation permissions.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
CommunityRequest
```
### Errors
403 | 404

Promotes `targetUserId` to moderator in `communityId`. The target user must already be a community member and the caller must have permission.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
CommunityMember
```
### Errors
403 | 404

Removes moderator role from `targetUserId` in `communityId`. Requires permission from the community owner or authorized moderator flow.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
CommunityMember
```
### Errors
403 | 404

Bans `targetUserId` from `communityId` with an optional reason. Moderation rules prevent banning the owner and restrict banning moderators.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
{ reason?: string }
```
### Response
```typescript
CommunityBan
```
### Errors
400 cannot ban owner/moderator | 403

Removes the community ban for `targetUserId` in `communityId`.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
{ success: true }
```
### Errors
403 | 404

Lists banned users for `communityId`. Requires community moderation permissions.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
CommunityBan[]
```
### Errors
403

Deletes `communityId`. Only the community owner can delete a community.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
204 empty
```
### Errors
403 owner only | 404

Creates a private or group conversation. The authenticated user is added to `members` automatically if omitted; blocked users are rejected.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
CreateConversationBody
```
### Response
```typescript
Conversation
```
### Errors
403 blocked users | 401

Lists conversations where the authenticated user is a member.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
Conversation[]
```
### Errors
401

Lists messages for `conversationId` when the authenticated user is a member and the conversation is not blocked.

---

## Types
### Response
```typescript
Message[]
```
### Errors
403 blocked | 404 | 401

Sends a text message with optional attachments to `conversationId` as the authenticated member. Blocked conversations or non-members are rejected.

---

## Types
### Request body
```typescript
SendMessageBody
```
### Response
```typescript
Message
```
### Errors
403 forbidden or blocked | 404 | 401

```typescript
LocationUpdateBody
```
### Response
```typescript
UserLocation
```
### Errors
429 | 401

---

## Types

```typescript
UserLocation[]
```
